en: I think there's an intimacy that people have with Mozart.
zh: 我認為人們與莫札特之間有一種親密感。
ja: 人々はモーツァルトに親しみを感じていると思います。
local: I think there's an intimacy that people have with Mozart.
ja_pron: Hitobito wa Mōtsaruto ni shitashimi o kanjite iru to omoimasu.
native: I think there's an intimacy that people have with Mozart.

en: They feel like they know him, they love his music, they cherish it.
zh: 他們覺得自己認識他，愛他的音樂，珍惜它。
ja: 彼らは彼を知っているように感じ、彼の音楽を愛し、大切にしています。
local: They feel like they know him, they love his music, they cherish it.
ja_pron: Karera wa kare o shitte iru yō ni kanji, kare no ongaku o aishi, taisetsu ni shiteimasu.
native: They feel like they know him, they love his music, they cherish it.

en: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, one of the most renowned figures in classical music,
zh: 沃爾夫岡·阿瑪迪斯·莫札特，是古典音樂中最著名的人物之一，
ja: ヴォルフガング・アマデウス・モーツァルトは、クラシック音楽で最も有名な人物の一人です。
local: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, one of the most renowned figures in classical music,
ja_pron: Vorufugangu Amadeusu Mōtsaruto wa, kurashikku ongaku de mottomo yūmei na jinbutsu no hitori desu.
native: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, one of the most renowned figures in classical music,

en: is now center stage at New York's Morgan Library and Museum.
zh: 現在成為紐約摩根圖書館與博物館的焦點展覽。
ja: 現在、ニューヨークのモーガン図書館・博物館で中心的な展示となっています。
local: is now center stage at New York's Morgan Library and Museum.
ja_pron: Ima, Nyūyōku no Mōgan Toshokan Hakubutsukan de chūshin-teki na tenji to natte imasu.
native: is now center stage at New York's Morgan Library and Museum.

en: The exhibit is a collaboration with the Mozart Ham Foundation in Salzburg,
zh: 這個展覽是與位於薩爾茨堡的莫札特漢姆基金會合作的，
ja: この展示はザルツブルクのモーツァルト・ハム財団との共同企画です。
local: The exhibit is a collaboration with the Mozart Ham Foundation in Salzburg,
ja_pron: Kono tenji wa Zarutsuburuku no Mōtsaruto Hamu Zaidan to no kyōdō kikaku desu.
native: The exhibit is a collaboration with the Mozart Ham Foundation in Salzburg,

en: where the Austrian composer was born in 1756.
zh: 奧地利作曲家於1756年出生於此地。
ja: オーストリアの作曲家が1756年に生まれた場所です。
local: where the Austrian composer was born in 1756.
ja_pron: Ōsutoria no sakkyokuka ga 1756-nen ni umareta basho desu.
native: where the Austrian composer was born in 1756.

en: The story I most wanted to tell was that bridge between Mozart, the human being, and Mozart, the icon, the legend.
zh: 我最想講述的故事是莫札特作為一個人與作為偶像、傳奇之間的橋樑。
ja: 私が最も伝えたかったのは、人間としてのモーツァルトと、アイコンや伝説としてのモーツァルトの架け橋の話です。
local: The story I most wanted to tell was that bridge between Mozart, the human being, and Mozart, the icon, the legend.
ja_pron: Watashi ga mottomo tsutaetakatta no wa, ningen to shite no Mōtsaruto to, aikon ya densetsu to shite no Mōtsaruto no kakehashi no hanashi desu.
native: The story I most wanted to tell was that bridge between Mozart, the human being, and Mozart, the icon, the legend.

en: Robin McClellan is curator of the show, which includes a symphony of treasures,
zh: 羅賓·麥克萊倫是這個展覽的策展人，展出了一系列珍寶，
ja: ロビン・マクレランはこの展示のキュレーターで、宝物の交響曲のような展示内容です。
local: Robin McClellan is curator of the show, which includes a symphony of treasures,
ja_pron: Robin Makureran wa kono tenji no kyurētā de, takaramono no kōkyōkyoku no yō na tenji naiyō desu.
native: Robin McClellan is curator of the show, which includes a symphony of treasures,

en: like Mozart's earliest musical works, some created when he was just five years old.
zh: 例如莫札特最早期的音樂作品，有些是在他五歲時創作的。
ja: モーツァルトの最も初期の音楽作品もあり、彼がわずか5歳の時に作られたものもあります。
local: like Mozart's earliest musical works, some created when he was just five years old.
ja_pron: Mōtsaruto no mottomo shoki no ongaku sakuhin mo ari, kare ga wazuka 5-sai no toki ni tsukurareta mono mo arimasu.
native: like Mozart's earliest musical works, some created when he was just five years old.

en: Which is father lovingly noted down for him because Mozart was still too young to even write them himself.
zh: 這些作品是父親親切地為他記錄下來，因為莫札特當時還太年幼，無法自己書寫。
ja: モーツァルト自身がまだ書けないほど幼かったため、父親が愛情を込めて記録しました。
local: Which is father lovingly noted down for him because Mozart was still too young to even write them himself.
ja_pron: Mōtsaruto jishin ga mada kakenai hodo osanakatta tame, chichioya ga aijō o komete kiroku shimashita.
native: Which is father lovingly noted down for him because Mozart was still too young to even write them himself.

en: Mozart wasn't the only prodigy in his family.
zh: 莫札特並非家中唯一的神童。
ja: モーツァルトだけが家族の中の神童ではありませんでした。
local: Mozart wasn't the only prodigy in his family.
ja_pron: Mōtsaruto dake ga kazoku no naka no shindō de wa arimasen deshita.
native: Mozart wasn't the only prodigy in his family.

en: The exhibit also highlights his lesser known older sister, Maria Ana, nicknamed Nano.
zh: 展覽還突顯了他較不為人知的姊姊瑪麗亞·安娜，綽號納諾。
ja: 展示では、あまり知られていない姉のマリア・アナ、通称ナノも紹介されています。
local: The exhibit also highlights his lesser known older sister, Maria Ana, nicknamed Nano.
ja_pron: Tenji de wa, amari shirarete inai ane no Maria Ana, tsūshō Nano mo shōkai sarete imasu.
native: The exhibit also highlights his lesser known older sister, Maria Ana, nicknamed Nano.

en: It's the final measure of music in the only known composition that she wrote, and so it's tiny, but incredibly meaningful.
zh: 這是她唯一已知作品中的最後一小節，雖然短小，卻意義非凡。
ja: 彼女が書いた唯一の作品の最後の小節で、小さいですが非常に意味深いです。
local: It's the final measure of music in the only known composition that she wrote, and so it's tiny, but incredibly meaningful.
ja_pron: Kanojo ga kaita yuiitsu no sakuhin no saigo no shōsetsu de, chiisai desu ga hijō ni imishinai desu.
native: It's the final measure of music in the only known composition that she wrote, and so it's tiny, but incredibly meaningful.

en: Leopold Mozart, his father, was an entrepreneur in a sense, touring the children around Europe, making a big impression,
zh: 他的父親利奧波德·莫札特在某種意義上是個企業家，帶著孩子們巡迴歐洲，留下深刻印象，
ja: 彼の父レオポルト・モーツァルトはある意味で起業家で、子供たちをヨーロッパ中に連れて回り、大きな印象を残しました。
local: Leopold Mozart, his father, was an entrepreneur in a sense, touring the children around Europe, making a big impression,
ja_pron: Kare no chichi Reoporuto Mōtsaruto wa aru imi de kigyōka de, kodomotachi o Yōroppa-jū ni tsurete mawari, ōkina inshō o nokoshimashita.
native: Leopold Mozart, his father, was an entrepreneur in a sense, touring the children around Europe, making a big impression,

en: and he even had the idea to sell what we might call merch nowadays.
zh: 他甚至想到販售現在所謂的周邊商品。
ja: 彼は今でいうグッズを販売するというアイデアも持っていました。
local: and he even had the idea to sell what we might call merch nowadays.
ja_pron: Kare wa ima de iu guzzu o hanbai suru to iu aidea mo motte imashita.
native: and he even had the idea to sell what we might call merch nowadays.

en: This was sold as a souvenir to anyone who was lucky enough to come and hear the Mozart children perform.
zh: 這些商品作為紀念品出售給有幸來聽莫札特孩子們表演的人。
ja: これはモーツァルトの子供たちの演奏を聴く幸運な人々にお土産として販売されました。
local: This was sold as a souvenir to anyone who was lucky enough to come and hear the Mozart children perform.
ja_pron: Kore wa Mōtsaruto no kodomotachi no ensō o kiku kōun na hitobito ni omiyage to shite hanbai saremashita.
native: This was sold as a souvenir to anyone who was lucky enough to come and hear the Mozart children perform.

en: The exhibit even shares details about the young composer's romantic life.
zh: 展覽甚至分享了這位年輕作曲家的浪漫生活細節。
ja: 展示では若き作曲家の恋愛生活の詳細も紹介されています。
local: The exhibit even shares details about the young composer's romantic life.
ja_pron: Tenji de wa wakaki sakkyokuka no ren'ai seikatsu no shōsai mo shōkai sarete imasu.
native: The exhibit even shares details about the young composer's romantic life.

en: Here's a flirtatious letter written at age 21 to his first cousin.
zh: 這是一封他21歲時寫給表姐的調情信。
ja: これは彼が21歳の時に最初のいとこに書いた軽い口調の手紙です。
local: Here's a flirtatious letter written at age 21 to his first cousin.
ja_pron: Kore wa kare ga 21-sai no toki ni saisho no itoko ni kaita karui kuchō no tegami desu.
native: Here's a flirtatious letter written at age 21 to his first cousin.

en: Back then, that sort of relationship was not uncommon.
zh: 當時，這種關係並不罕見。
ja: 当時、そのような関係は珍しくありませんでした。
local: Back then, that sort of relationship was not uncommon.
ja_pron: Tōji, sono yō na kankei wa mezurashiku arimasen deshita.
native: Back then, that sort of relationship was not uncommon.

en: His letters are famous for bathroom humor and sexual innuendo, so toward the end of the letter he says to her,
zh: 他的信件以廁所幽默和性暗示聞名，因此在信的結尾他對她說，
ja: 彼の手紙はトイレジョークや性的なほのめかしで有名で、手紙の終わりに彼は彼女にこう言っています。
local: His letters are famous for bathroom humor and sexual innuendo, so toward the end of the letter he says to her,
ja_pron: Kare no tegami wa toire jōku ya seiteki na honomekashi de yūmei de, tegami no owari ni kare wa kanojo ni kō itte imasu.
native: His letters are famous for bathroom humor and sexual innuendo, so toward the end of the letter he says to her,

en: I sign with such affection and love.
zh: 我以深情與愛意簽名。
ja: 私は深い愛情と愛を込めて署名します。
local: I sign with such affection and love.
ja_pron: Watashi wa fukai aijō to ai o komete shomei shimasu.
native: I sign with such affection and love.

en: I kiss you on your face, on your hands, on your knees, and anywhere else you'll let me kiss you.
zh: 我親吻你的臉、手、膝蓋，以及你願意讓我親吻的任何地方。
ja: あなたの顔や手、膝、そして私がキスしてもいい場所ならどこでもキスします。
local: I kiss you on your face, on your hands, on your knees, and anywhere else you'll let me kiss you.
ja_pron: Anata no kao ya te, hiza, soshite watashi ga kisu shite mo ii basho nara doko demo kisu shimasu.
native: I kiss you on your face, on your hands, on your knees, and anywhere else you'll let me kiss you.

en: Also on display on this side of the Atlantic for the very first time, Mozart's childhood violin.
zh: 此外，莫札特童年時期的小提琴也首次在大西洋這邊展出。
ja: また、大西洋のこちら側で初めて展示されるモーツァルトの子供時代のバイオリンもあります。
local: Also on display on this side of the Atlantic for the very first time, Mozart's childhood violin.
ja_pron: Mata, Taiseiyō no kochira-gawa de hajimete tenji sareru Mōtsaruto no kodomo jidai no baiorin mo arimasu.
native: Also on display on this side of the Atlantic for the very first time, Mozart's childhood violin.

en: And the clever chord he used to compose some of his most acclaimed operas.
zh: 以及他用來創作一些最受讚譽歌劇的巧妙和弦。
ja: そして、彼が最も称賛されたオペラのいくつかを作曲するために使った巧妙な和音も展示されています。
local: And the clever chord he used to compose some of his most acclaimed operas.
ja_pron: Soshite, kare ga mottomo shōsan sareta opera no ikutsu ka o sakkyoku suru tame ni tsukatta kōmyō na waon mo tenji sarete imasu.
native: And the clever chord he used to compose some of his most acclaimed operas.

en: Here you see ink spots where Mozart spilled ink as he was composing, probably in a hurry, you know, composing multiple pieces at once.
zh: 這裡可以看到莫札特在作曲時灑出的墨跡，可能是匆忙中同時創作多首作品。
ja: ここには、モーツァルトが作曲中にインクをこぼした跡が見られます。おそらく急いで複数の作品を同時に作曲していたのでしょう。
local: Here you see ink spots where Mozart spilled ink as he was composing, probably in a hurry, you know, composing multiple pieces at once.
ja_pron: Koko ni wa, Mōtsaruto ga sakkyoku-chū ni inku o koboshita ato ga mirareru. Osoraku isoide fukusū no sakuhin o dōji ni sakkyoku shite ita no deshō.
native: Here you see ink spots where Mozart spilled ink as he was composing, probably in a hurry, you know, composing multiple pieces at once.

en: One of the most lovely aspects of this actually is this note that was placed into the clever chord by his wife,
zh: 其中最美好的一點是這張由他妻子放入巧妙和弦中的便條，
ja: これの最も素敵な点の一つは、彼の妻が巧妙な和音に入れたこのメモです。
local: One of the most lovely aspects of this actually is this note that was placed into the clever chord by his wife,
ja_pron: Kore no mottomo suteki na ten no hitotsu wa, kare no tsuma ga kōmyō na waon ni ireta kono memo desu.
native: One of the most lovely aspects of this actually is this note that was placed into the clever chord by his wife,

en: Constanza, after his death, where she attests to his authenticity and says,
zh: 康斯坦札在他去世後證明了這點，並說，
ja: 彼の死後、コンスタンツァが彼の本物であることを証明し、こう言っています。
local: Constanza, after his death, where she attests to his authenticity and says,
ja_pron: Kare no shigo, Konsutantsua ga kare no honmono de aru koto o shōmei shi, kō itte imasu.
native: Constanza, after his death, where she attests to his authenticity and says,

en: this was the instrument my husband used to compose the magic flute, the requiem, and many other of his most famous pieces.
zh: 這是我丈夫用來創作《魔笛》、《安魂曲》及其他多首著名作品的樂器。
ja: これは夫が『魔笛』や『レクイエム』、その他多くの有名な作品を作曲するために使った楽器です。
local: this was the instrument my husband used to compose the magic flute, the requiem, and many other of his most famous pieces.
ja_pron: Kore wa otto ga 'Madeki' ya 'Rekuiemu', sono ta ōku no yūmei na sakuhin o sakkyoku suru tame ni tsukatta gakki desu.
native: this was the instrument my husband used to compose the magic flute, the requiem, and many other of his most famous pieces.

en: Mozart was working on his famous requiem when he died in 1791.
zh: 莫札特於1791年去世時，正致力於創作他著名的安魂曲。
ja: モーツァルトは1791年に亡くなる時、有名なレクイエムに取り組んでいました。
local: Mozart was working on his famous requiem when he died in 1791.
ja_pron: Mōtsaruto wa 1791-nen ni nakunaru toki, yūmei na rekuiemu ni torikunde imashita.
native: Mozart was working on his famous requiem when he died in 1791.

en: He was just 35.
zh: 他當時只有35歲。
ja: 彼はわずか35歳でした。
local: He was just 35.
ja_pron: Kare wa wazuka 35-sai deshita.
native: He was just 35.

en: He died young, people began to realize more and more what a rare and incredible composer he was, and that became the legend that we know today.
zh: 他英年早逝，人們開始越來越認識到他是多麼罕見且了不起的作曲家，這也成為了我們今天所知的傳奇。
ja: 彼は若くして亡くなりましたが、人々は彼がどれほど希有で素晴らしい作曲家であったかを次第に理解し、それが今日私たちが知る伝説となりました。
local: He died young, people began to realize more and more what a rare and incredible composer he was, and that became the legend that we know today.
ja_pron: Kare wa wakakushite nakunarimashita ga, hitobito wa kare ga dore hodo keu de subarashii sakkyokuka de atta ka o shidai ni rikai shi, sore ga kyō watashitachi ga shiru densetsu to narimashita.
native: He died young, people began to realize more and more what a rare and incredible composer he was, and that became the legend that we know today.

en: A legend burnished by other classical music greats, Chopin, Mendelssohn, and Beethoven all helped enhance Mozart's legacy.
zh: 這個傳奇由其他古典音樂巨匠如蕭邦、孟德爾頌和貝多芬共同錘煉，幫助提升了莫札特的遺產。
ja: この伝説はショパン、メンデルスゾーン、ベートーヴェンなどの他のクラシック音楽の偉大な作曲家たちによって磨かれ、モーツァルトの遺産を高めました。
local: A legend burnished by other classical music greats, Chopin, Mendelssohn, and Beethoven all helped enhance Mozart's legacy.
ja_pron: Kono densetsu wa Shopan, Menderusuzōn, Bētōven nado no hoka no kurashikku ongaku no idaina sakkyokuka-tachi ni yotte migakare, Mōtsaruto no isan o takamemashita.
native: A legend burnished by other classical music greats, Chopin, Mendelssohn, and Beethoven all helped enhance Mozart's legacy.

en: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, a short life in many acts with a body of work that resonates to this day.
zh: 沃爾夫岡·阿瑪迪斯·莫札特，短暫的一生卻留下至今仍迴響的作品。
ja: ヴォルフガング・アマデウス・モーツァルト、多くの幕がある短い人生で、今日まで響き続ける作品群を残しました。
local: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, a short life in many acts with a body of work that resonates to this day.
ja_pron: Vorufugangu Amadeusu Mōtsaruto, ōku no maku ga aru mijikai jinsei de, kyō made hibiki tsuzukeru sakuhin-gun o nokoshimashita.
native: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, a short life in many acts with a body of work that resonates to this day.

en: I'll see you next time.
zh: 下次再見。
ja: また次回お会いしましょう。
local: I'll see you next time.
ja_pron: Mata jikai o ai shimashō.
native: I'll see you next time.
